queries: WITH pairs AS (SELECT s.transref, tr.tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_opt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg GROUP BY s.transref, tr.tradekind), overall AS (SELECT AVG(s.optvolrt) AS overall_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg), dev AS (SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.avg_opt, ABS(p.avg_opt - o.overall_avg) AS deviation FROM pairs p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL), typed AS (SELECT d.*, AVG(d.deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY d.tradekind) AS type_avg_dev FROM dev d WHERE d.tradekind IS NOT NULL) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_opt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(deviation - type_avg_dev) AS avg_excess FROM typed WHERE deviation > type_avg_dev GROUP BY tradekind

WITH joined AS (SELECT s.transref, tr.tradekind, s.optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg), overall AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS ov FROM joined), pairs AS (SELECT j.transref, j.tradekind, AVG(j.optvolrt) AS avg_opt, ABS(AVG(j.optvolrt) - o.ov) AS dev FROM joined j CROSS JOIN overall o GROUP BY j.transref, j.tradekind, o.ov HAVING o.ov IS NOT NULL), typed AS (SELECT p.*, AVG(p.dev) OVER (PARTITION BY p.tradekind) AS type_avg_dev FROM pairs p WHERE p.tradekind IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT tradekind, avg_opt, dev, dev - type_avg_dev AS excess FROM typed WHERE dev > type_avg_dev) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_opt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(dev) AS avg_deviation, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind

assumptions.assumption: The overall average option volume ratio is the mean of optvolrt over all fully joined sentiment rows (sentiment, transaction and trader), not the mean of the pair averages.
Deviation is the absolute difference between a pair's average and the overall average.
The type's average deviation is taken over all of that type's pairs with a non-null deviation, before filtering. A pair is kept only if its deviation is strictly greater than that average.

alternatives.interpretation: Deviation is signed (pair average minus overall average) instead of absolute.
